text: Most small businesses don't need another SEO report. They need the work done.
Other tools hand you a score and a long list of things to fix. Then it's on you to figure out the rest.
GravyBlock starts differently. Enter a real website, and run the free scan.
In moments you see a visibility score, and exactly what's holding the business back.
Behind the scan, GravyBlock learns your real business: what you do, where, and for whom. It keeps that record current, and never claims what your own website doesn't say.
Then it looks across your website, your Google profile, reviews, links and A I search, finds the openings, and ranks the ones actually worth doing.
And then it does the work. It publishes pages to your site, posts to Google, replies to reviews, and pitches local sites for links.
Every action is checked against the live result. Only verified work counts, and anything not yet measured stays at zero.
GravyBlock can also make short marketing videos from your real website, like this one. You approve every video before anything goes public.
Meanwhile you're not managing a dashboard. It only asks you for a one time connection, or a rare exception.
